# Same resolution as the aarch64-macos leg (tools/resolve_closure; every .gem
# sha256 == its /info/<gem> checksum, re-verified against the downloaded .gem)
# with the five precompiled natives swapped for their glibc-x86_64 variants
# (nokogiri/ffi/sqlite3 ship -x86_64-linux-gnu, libpng/parsanol ship plain
# -x86_64-linux; both spellings match a linux-gnu x86_64 ruby under rubygems'
# normalized-linux platform rule). The six source-only natives (brotli, ox,
# oga, ruby-ll, psych, websocket-driver) stay per-triplet source builds —
# the POSIX shim staging, same shape as the macOS leg (tools/build).
